neverConnected.title: This node enrolled but its agent never connected
neverConnected.description: The join token is already used, so the agent cannot retry on its own. Check the agent logs on the host (for example, the identity directory may not be writable), then clean up this node and enrol it again with a new join token. A node that never connects is also removed automatically after a while.
neverConnected.cleanedUp: Removed {{name}}, its name is free again

join.title: Add node
join.description: Generates a single-use join token. Run the command it produces on the new machine to connect its agent to this control plane.
join.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter. Leave empty to let the agent report its hostname.
join.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.
join.addrHint: Host and port the new machine can reach this control plane on, port 9443 by default. Pre-filled with the advertise address the agent certificate covers (APP_AGENT_ADVERTISE_HOST). A different name fails the TLS check.
join.meshHint: Connect the node to the WireGuard mesh so apps and databases can reach each other across machines. Needs mesh networking enabled on the control plane.
join.createdDescription: Run the command below on the new machine to enroll it. The token is a one-time bootstrap credential, not something to save long-term.
join.singleUse: Single use. This token will not be shown again and expires at {{time}}.
join.dockerHint: Recommended. Runs the agent as a container on the new machine.
join.podmanHint: Rootful Podman. The agent mounts /run/podman/podman.sock, so the socket must be enabled first (command below).
join.podmanSocketLabel: Podman prerequisite (run once on the new machine)
join.binaryHint: For a machine without Docker run access for the agent container, or when you manage the service yourself.
join.fallbackHint: This control plane did not return ready-made commands, so this one is built from the address above.
join.afterRun: There is no live status check here. Once the agent connects, the node appears in the node list. Give the node a name to follow it live.
join.providerHint: Auto-detect reads the cloud's metadata service on the node. For a home server or a provider without one, pick it here and type the region and zone.
join.domainInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, up to 63 characters.
join.afterRunLive: Run the command on the new machine. Progress appears below as soon as the agent contacts this control plane.

move.title: Move "{{name}}" to another node
move.descriptionApp: The move is verified at each step and rolled back automatically if the target cannot run the app. Traffic is held while the target comes up.
move.descriptionDatabase: The database and its data volume are copied to the target and verified before the old copy is stopped. Apps that use it are restarted afterwards.
move.noTargets: There are no other nodes to move this to. Add a node first.
move.statefulWarning: {{name}} has data volumes ({{volumes}}), so it is stopped while they are copied. Expect downtime that grows with volume size.
move.statelessNote: {{name}} is staged on the target and verified before the old copy stops, so there should be no downtime.
move.failedFallback: The move failed partway through. Check the steps above for the phase that failed.
move.rolledBackHint: {{name}} is still on its original node. Fix the error above, then try the move again.
move.failedHint: The move stopped at the phase marked failed. Fix the cause, then start the move again.

drain.title: Drain "{{name}}"?
drain.description: Cordons this node, then moves its databases first and its apps after them. Apps follow their database when that node is eligible. The drain stops at the first failed move and leaves the node cordoned.
drain.emptyDone: Nothing was placed on this node, so there was nothing to move.
drain.runningHint: This updates every couple of seconds. You can close this dialog, the drain keeps running.
drain.failedHint: The node stays cordoned. Fix the cause shown on the failed move, then drain again, or uncordon the node to put it back in rotation.

drains.title: Drains
drains.description: Recent drains of this node, newest first.
drains.empty: This node has not been drained.
drains.emptyHint: Use Drain at the top of this page to move its apps and databases elsewhere.
drains.loadFailed: Could not load the drain history.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Key and value pairs that apps and databases can select on with a placement selector. Saving replaces the whole set.
labels.emptyHint: Add one, for example disk = ssd, then require it from an app's placement.
labels.keyRule: Keys: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash and slash, 1 to 63 characters.
labels.valueRule: Values: letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash, 1 to 63 characters. At most 32 labels.
labels.duplicate: Each key can be used once.
labels.incomplete: Fill in both a key and a value, or remove the empty row.
labels.knownHint: region, zone and provider name this node's failure domain. When zones are set, replicas spread across them.

zones.title: Failure domains
zones.description: How workloads spread across zones. With zone labels set, new placements and drains prefer the zone carrying the fewest workloads.
zones.unlabeledBody: Without a zone label on at least one node, replicas are not spread across failure domains.
zones.fix: Set a zone on a node
zones.concentrated: Most workloads sit in one zone, so losing it takes most of them down.

whatIf.title: What if
whatIf.failureHint: Pick a zone to see where its workloads would be rescheduled. Nothing is moved.
whatIf.failureSummary: {{lost}} nodes lost, {{displaced}} workloads displaced, {{stuck}} with nowhere to go.
whatIf.failureOk: Every displaced workload fits on the surviving nodes.
whatIf.failureStuck: Add capacity outside this zone, or loosen selectors, to survive losing it.
whatIf.invalid: Enter whole numbers, with at least one app.

placement.title: Placement
placement.selectorHint: Only nodes with all of these labels are eligible. Changing the selector never moves anything by itself.
placement.selectorEmpty: No selector: any schedulable node is eligible.
placement.eligibleEmpty: No node matches. Relax the selector, label a node, or uncordon one.
placement.duplicate: Each key can be used once.
placement.incomplete: Fill in both a key and a value, or remove the empty row.
placement.unknownHint: This placement points at node {{id}}, which no longer exists.
placement.moveFailed: Could not move it to this server.

allocation.title: Capacity
allocation.description: What the apps and databases on this node request, against what the node can allocate.
allocation.unknown: Not reported yet. Placement treats this as unknown, not as empty or unlimited.
allocation.policy: {{workloads}} workloads. Allocatable is {{cpu}}% of CPU and {{memory}}% of memory, with {{disk}}% of disk kept free.
allocation.empty: This node is not in the allocation list yet.

decision.noneRecorded: No placement decision was recorded for this one. It was placed before decisions were kept, or it runs on the local server by default.
decision.nothingFits: No node has room for it right now. Free capacity, add a node, or pick a node yourself.
decision.loadFailed: Could not load the placement decision.

connectivity.title: Node connectivity
connectivity.description: How every node's WireGuard view of every other node looks, one row per pair.
connectivity.offDescription: Nodes cannot reach each other over WireGuard, so apps cannot use a database on another node. Set APP_MESH_ENABLED=1 on the control plane and restart it to turn it on.
connectivity.emptyDescription: Pair diagnostics appear once a second node has joined the mesh.
connectivity.viewError: {{node}} could not report its mesh view: {{error}}

list.title: Nodes
list.description: Servers this control plane places apps and databases on.
list.name: Name
list.emptyTitle: This server is your only node
list.emptyDescription: Everything runs on the machine hosting the control plane. Add a server to spread apps and databases across machines, keep builds off production, or add capacity without resizing this one.

cordon.title: Cordon "{{name}}"?
cordon.description: This node stops accepting new app and database placements immediately. Everything already running on it keeps running. Use drain to move existing workloads off.

uncordon.title: Uncordon "{{name}}"?
uncordon.description: This node starts accepting new app and database placements again. Nothing is moved back onto it automatically.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: This removes the node from the registry only. It does not drain the node or stop its agent: if the agent is still running it stays connected and its workloads keep running.

sshVerify.title: Verify the server
sshVerify.description: These host keys were read from {{host}}:{{port}} without sending any credential. Confirm one matches the server before continuing.
sshVerify.compareHint: Compare this with the output of this command run on the server:
sshVerify.confirm: I compared this fingerprint with the server and it matches
sshVerify.noKeys: The server presented no host key.

agent.title: Agent
agent.localBody: This node runs inside the control plane itself, with no network link to secure, so no agent certificate is used. It is not an agent that can go offline: it is as available as this dashboard.

revoke.title: Revoke "{{name}}"'s certificate?
revoke.description: The control plane stops trusting this node's agent right away.
revoke.consequenceRefused: Every connection and renewal from this certificate is refused from now on.
revoke.consequenceSession: The node's live session is closed immediately.
revoke.consequenceWorkloads: Workloads already running there keep running but can no longer be managed.
revoke.consequenceReenroll: Only re-enrolling the node brings it back.

trust.loading: Checking how this node is verified...
trust.loadError: Could not load this node's security details.
trust.rootOnly: Certificate fingerprints, renewal details and security events are visible to root accounts.

status.verified: Connection verified: mutual TLS, certificate matches this node
status.rejected: Recent connections were rejected ({{reason}}). Check the events below.
status.revoked: Certificate revoked: every connection is refused until the node is re-enrolled
status.idle: Not connected right now. Its last connection was verified.
status.no_activity: No connection from this node has been recorded yet

trust.caCompare: Compare with APP_CA_FINGERPRINT in the agent's environment, or the fingerprint its enrollment command printed.

pin.pinned: Pinned at enrollment: the agent checked this fingerprint before it sent its join token.
pin.trusted_ca: Re-enrolled against the CA already on the node.
pin.unpinned: Not pinned: the agent trusted the control plane on first use. Re-enroll with APP_CA_FINGERPRINT set to pin it.

trust.lifetimeUsed: Share of the certificate's lifetime used
trust.estimated: estimated until the agent reports its own

key.agent: Generated on the node. The private key never left it: the control plane only signed a request.
key.reenroll_required: Generated by the control plane (an early beta). Re-enroll required: this node will not renew until you re-enroll it.

reasons.mutual_tls_verified: mutual TLS verified, certificate matches this node
reasons.not_yet_valid: certificate not yet valid (check the node's clock)
reasons.fingerprint_mismatch: fingerprint does not match this node's record
reasons.trusted_ca: verified against the CA already on the node
reasons.not_pinned: not pinned, trusted on first use
reasons.sign_failed: the request could not be signed
reasons.agent_upgrade_required: agent too old to enroll, upgrade it
reasons.reenroll_required: re-enroll required, the node's key was made by the control plane

drill.title: Rotation drill for "{{name}}"
drill.description: Rotates this node's certificate end to end and checks each step. The old certificate stays valid, so a failed drill changes nothing.
drill.failed: Drill failed. The node still uses its previous certificate.

trust.renewOffline: The node must be connected to renew on demand
trust.renewDescription: Asks the connected agent to renew its certificate right away instead of at its scheduled time.
trust.renewConsequenceVerify: The agent tests the new certificate against the control plane before it switches to it.
trust.renewConsequenceKeep: If anything fails, the node keeps its current certificate and the failure shows here.
trust.renewConsequenceAudit: The request is recorded in the audit log and the node's security events.

reenroll.title: Re-enroll "{{name}}"
reenroll.description: Issues this node a new agent certificate while keeping its identity, placements and history. Use it when the node was offline past its certificate's expiry, or after revoking its certificate. The old certificate stops working as soon as the node re-enrolls.
reenroll.shownOnce: This token will not be shown again. It works once and expires at {{time}}.
reenroll.addrHint: Host and port the node reaches this control plane on, port 9443 by default.
reenroll.afterHint: A running agent picks up the new certificate at its next reconnect; otherwise start the agent after this command.

joinTokens.description: Anyone holding an unused join token can enroll a node. Revoke the ones you no longer need, a revoked token stops working at once.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.waiting: Waiting for the first host reading from this node.
capacity.blocked: New builds and deploys on this node are blocked: {{reason}}. The running version keeps serving. Free space to unblock.
capacity.cleanupUnsupported: Cleanup runs on the control plane node only for now. Free space on this node directly.
capacity.dialogBody: Review what would be removed. Rollback images and volumes are never deleted.

dangling_images.title: Dangling images
dangling_images.hint: Untagged image layers no container uses.

build_cache.title: Build cache
build_cache.hint: Idle build cache past its age limit or over budget.

stopped_containers.title: Stopped containers
stopped_containers.hint: Exited containers no app still wants.

rollback_images.title: Images kept for rollback
rollback_images.hint: Tagged images that a rollback may need.

orphaned_volumes.title: Orphaned volumes
orphaned_volumes.hint: Shown for review only. Volumes are never deleted from here.

capacity.settingsHint: Leave a field empty to use the control plane default. Disk, inode and memory values are percent free, swap is percent used.
capacity.autoCleanHint: When this node is low, remove dangling images, idle build cache and stopped containers on its own. Off by default.

failure.title: Failure handling
failure.description: What happens when this node stays unreachable. Stateless apps can move to healthy nodes. Apps and databases with node-local data never move on their own.
failure.healthy: This node is reachable. Nothing to do.

class.reschedule: Stateless: can start on a healthy node
class.needs_decision: Has node-local data: needs your decision

failure.restoreHint: The resource is placed on a healthy node. Restore its data from a backup there.

resolved.wait: Waiting for the node to return
resolved.restore: Placed on another node. Restore its data from a backup there.

failure.lostDescription: Stateless apps move to healthy nodes now. Anything with node-local data stays put until you decide. If the node returns, stale copies are stopped.
failure.graceHint: 0 uses the default. Otherwise at least 30.

resilience.title: Resilience check
resilience.description: Will your apps keep serving if the control plane goes down? This checks the saved state a restart would rely on.
resilience.simulatedNote: Dry run: nothing was stopped. The saved state was opened the way a restart would open it.

region.title: Failure domain
region.regionHint: A label such as eu-central or home-lab. New replicas prefer a region that holds fewer of the app's other replicas.
region.zoneHint: The smallest failure domain, such as a datacenter or availability zone. Replicas spread across zones first.
region.description: Filled in automatically for nodes created from a cloud provider. Clear a field to remove that label.

banner.description: Add servers to spread apps and databases across machines. A WireGuard mesh links every node back to this control plane.

placed.title: Running on this node
placed.none: Nothing is placed on this node yet.

banner.pending: This node is enrolled and waiting for its agent to connect.
banner.online: Agent connected. Cordon or drain this node before maintenance.
banner.offline: The agent is not reachable, so nothing new is placed here.
banner.cordoned: New placements are paused. Running workloads are untouched.

statusCard.title: Status
statusCard.pending: Waiting for the agent to connect
statusCard.uncordonHint: Use Uncordon in the header to resume placements.

workloads.title: Workload capabilities
workloads.appsHint: Whether this node is eligible for new application placements.
workloads.buildsHint: A routing preference for where new builds run, not a hard placement rule.
workloads.buildsTip: Sets whether new builds prefer this node. It does not move apps or databases already running here, and it does not guarantee builds never run here: if no node that accepts builds is currently healthy, a build still runs on the primary node rather than failing.

onboarding.title: Joining {{name}}
onboarding.waiting: Waiting for the agent to contact the control plane. This page updates by itself.
onboarding.waitingFacts: The agent is connected and is collecting its preflight facts.
onboarding.notDetected: No provider, region or zone was detected. Set them on the node page, or rerun the agent with the labels from the join form.
onboarding.applied: Labels on this node: provider {{provider}}, region {{region}}, zone {{zone}}.
onboarding.stale: The agent stopped reporting, so these results may be out of date.

domains.title: Capacity by failure domain
domains.description: Reported CPU, memory and free disk per provider, region and zone. Beta: capacity comes from what each node reports.
domains.capacity: {{cores}} cores, {{memory}} GiB memory, {{disk}} GiB free disk
domains.unverified_one: ({{count}} node has not reported its capacity)
domains.unverified_other: ({{count}} nodes have not reported their capacity)
domains.unlabeled_one: {{count}} of {{total}} nodes has no provider, region or zone label.
domains.unlabeled_other: {{count}} of {{total}} nodes have no provider, region or zone label.
domains.noLabels: No node has a provider, region or zone label yet. Add a node with auto-detect, or label an existing one on its page.
domains.loadFailed: Could not load the domain overview.
